subject: Shiny application on private GitHub repo

messages.author: 8c9322b045b66ff8
messages.subject: Shiny application on private GitHub repo
parts:
Hi everyone,
I am developing a Shiny (local) application for a private project. The project is hosted in a private GitHub repo and shared among colleagues and customers.

There is some ways to use runGitHub with a private repo? If not, what about alternatives?

Thank you very much for help.

Nicola

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny application on private GitHub repo
parts: It's not currently possible to use runGitHub with private repos, sorry. You'd have to have your users download the app using some other Git client first. Or maybe you could use a secret gist with runGist, if you don't need the greater security that private repos provide.
